content.title: AngioDynamics: Fiscal Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: LATHAM, N.Y. (AP) — AngioDynamics Inc. (ANGO) on Tuesday reported a loss of $6.4 million in its fiscal second quarter.  On a per-share basis, the Latham, New York-based company said it had a loss of 15 cents.  Earnings, adjusted for costs related to mergers and acquisitions and amortization costs, came to less than 1 cent on a per-share basis.
